svg.aria-label: Eddy currents: a plate moving past a magnet pole carries one current whirl where it enters the field and an opposite one where it leaves, and the force on them drags the plate; slots and laminations break the whirls up
svg.text: Eddy currents: whirls of induced current inside solid metal

text.tspan: Eddy currents — magnetic braking, and why cores are slotted and laminated
